{
  "labels": [
    {"i": 0, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Hello Tamil ji, you are looking for 7.50 or 16 Apollo andure tire, right?"},
    {"i": 1, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Yes, ma'am."},
    {"i": 2, "speaker": "bot", "text": "The seller you were trying to reach is unavailable and I'm calling from the IndiaMART help desk."},
    {"i": 3, "speaker": "bot", "text": "How many piece or pair do you need?"},
    {"i": 4, "speaker": "caller", "text": "I need single piece."},
    {"i": 5, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Do you need one piece?"},
    {"i": 6, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Yes, sir."},
    {"i": 7, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Got it."},
    {"i": 8, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Let's talk about tire size now."},
    {"i": 9, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Which one would you like?"},
    {"i": 10, "speaker": "caller", "text": "10, 0 to 20 or something else?"},
    {"i": 11, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Done."},
    {"i": 12, "speaker": "caller", "text": "No."},
    {"i": 13, "speaker": "caller", "text": "One square."},
    {"i": 14, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Sorry, I couldn't catch that clearly."},
    {"i": 15, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Which seller size do you prefer?"},
    {"i": 16, "speaker": "bot", "text": "For 10, 0 to 20 or something else."},
    {"i": 17, "speaker": "caller", "text": "No ma'am."},
    {"i": 18, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Only one."},
    {"i": 19, "speaker": "bot", "text": "I understand."},
    {"i": 20, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Since you're unsure about the size, the seller will help you with this."},
    {"i": 21, "speaker": "bot", "text": "What would you prefer for tire construction, radial, nylon, or something else?"},
    {"i": 22, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Radial."},
    {"i": 23, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Perfect."},
    {"i": 24, "speaker": "bot", "text": "I'll send you the seller details on WhatsApp where you can discuss the details and price directly."},
    {"i": 25, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Okay, ma'am."},
    {"i": 26, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Thank you for choosing IndiaMART."},
    {"i": 27, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Have a nice day."},
    {"i": 28, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Okay ma'am."},
    {"i": 29, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Let's do."}
  ]
}
